name: Miniball
blurb: Miniball is an exciting 2D multiplayer soccer game where you can compete against players from around the world.
description:
Miniball is an exciting 2D multiplayer soccer game where you can compete
against players from around the world. Master the physics-based controls,
create strategies with your teammates, and score amazing goals!

Key Features:

• Real-time multiplayer matches with low latency

• Physics-based ball control and dribbling mechanics

• Create custom rooms with adjustable time, score limits, and map sizes (1v1 to 4v4)

• Global server browser with ping-based sorting

• Spectator mode and detailed match statistics

• In-game chat and team coordination

• Cross-platform account system with guest support
